title: Beyond Budgeting at 25 (white paper, March 2023)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF text extracted). The Beyond Budgeting model was developed in 1998; its 12 principles, six on leadership and six on management processes, including relative targets, lean and unbiased forecasts, resources made available as needed, holistic performance evaluation and coordination around business rhythms rather than the calendar year.

title: Corporate Budgeting Is Broken, Let's Fix It (Michael C. Jensen, November 2001)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Jensen argues that budgeting pushes managers to set low targets and inflate results, penalises those who tell the truth and turns decisions into games.

title: Zero-Based Budgeting Is Not a Wonder Diet for Companies (Daniel Mahler, June 2016)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Zero-based budgeting requires each expense to be justified every budget period from demonstrable needs and costs, rather than starting from last year's budget.

title: SaaS Metrics 2.0: A Guide to Measuring and Improving What Matters
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Rules of thumb from the author: the best SaaS businesses have LTV to CAC above 3; many recover CAC in 5 to 7 months, and beyond 12 months profitability is weak; net new MRR from new, expansion and churned MRR; negative churn.

supports: Opened with WebFetch. A SaaS company's growth rate plus profit margin should be at least 40%; growth measured as year-over-year MRR growth; EBITDA as the baseline profit measure.

title: 2025 B2B SaaS Retention Benchmarks (Research Brief 32)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF text extracted). 14th annual survey of more than 1,000 private B2B SaaS companies: median net revenue retention 101% and gross revenue retention 91%; month-to-month contracts 100% and 89%; multi-year contracts 103% and 94%; ACV above 250,000 dollars shows 95% median GRR; excludes companies under 1 million dollars ARR; NRR formula is December MRR from customers who were customers a year earlier divided by total MRR a year earlier, and GRR excludes upsells, cross-sells and price increases so cannot exceed 100%.

title: Billing analytics
supports: Opened with WebFetch.
